notes.title: Another World - 20th Anniversary Edition - Game Update
notes.content:
Dear community, dear fans,

Last month, we have updated the PC VERSION of Another World - 20th Anniversary for the first time on Steam.

Eric Chahi and our friends at Goblinz have developed this update to make this version similar to the console versions.

- All backgrounds of the game are now in 1080p 
- Fixing gameplay scripting  
- Fixing minor bug
- Adding 8 new languages :  Simplified Chinese - Brazilian Portuguese - Japanese - Korean - Portuguese - Polish - Russian and Turkish 

Thank you again for your support, and do not hesitate to reach our technical support to report any issue: support@thedigitalounge.com

Stay safe,

Digital Lounge Team

notes.title: SUPPORT THE BIOGRAPHY OF ANOTHER WORLD'S GAME DESIGNER
notes.content:
[img]http://bit.ly/1MFaxMj[/img]    [img]http://bit.ly/1iAOYyf[/img]

Find out about Eric Chahi, creator of Another World (aka, Out of This World) and From Dust, with this unique biography retracing his career as an artist and game designer. Written by Daniel Ichbiah, writer and journalist specializing in video games, Eric Chahi – Journey of a French Video Game Creator, takes you on a path full of magic and waking reveries, to the heart of the artist’s work, his inspirations, his world; the story of a man who dreamed about Another World…

Take the chance to rediscover the epic game Another World, one of Eric Chahi’s masterpieces remastered in HD within this dedicated boxset! Read the story of one of the greatest game designers of the 1990s through this unique work. Eric Chahi takes the reader backstage, from the dawn of microcomputing to French video game development in the 1980s and 1990s and the democratization of gaming. A fascinating glimpse of the birth of an industry, full of key moments, disappointments, rebounds and last-minute victories!

[h1][b]Support the translation of the biography in english on Kickstarter [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/1199708184/welcome-to-another-world]HERE[/url][/b][/h1]
